title: ATAC-seq Protocol for Astrocytes
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Tagmented DNA purified with Minelute PCR Purification Kit (Qiagen, Cat. #28004)
Nuclei isolated by cell lysis and cytosol removal
Cell viability and quantification assessed using a Countess Automated Cell Counter (ThermoFisher Scientific)

steps.title: Collect astrocyte cells
steps.instruction: Remove media from 2D astrocyte cultures, then centrifuge the cells at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes while keeping all steps on ice.

steps.title: Ship pelleted cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pelleted cells in an appropriate buffer (if needed) and ship them to Azenta/GENEWIZ for library preparation and sequencing.

steps.title: Thaw and DNase‑I treat cells
steps.instruction: Thaw live cell samples, wash them, and treat with DNase I (Life Tech, Cat. #EN0521) to remove genomic DNA contamination.

steps.title: Tagment nuclei with Tn5
steps.instruction: Incubate isolated nuclei with Tn5 transposase (Illumina, Cat. #20034197) for 30 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Barcode and amplify libraries
steps.instruction: Add Nextera Index Kit v2 (Illumina, Cat. #FC-131-2001) to the tagmented DNA, perform PCR amplification, and clean up the amplified libraries using SPRI beads.

steps.title: Convert BCL to FASTQ
steps.instruction: Convert raw .bcl files to FASTQ and demultiplex using bcl2fastq version 2.17, allowing 1 mismatch.

steps.title: Trim adapters and low‑quality bases
steps.instruction: Run Trimmomatic version 0.38 on the FASTQ files to remove adapters and low‑quality bases.

steps.title: Align reads to reference genome
steps.instruction: Align the trimmed reads to the human reference genome GRCh38 using bowtie2.

steps.title: Filter alignments
steps.instruction: Filter the bowtie2 alignments with samtools 1.9, keeping only primary alignments that are concordantly aligned with a minimum mapping quality of ≥30.

steps.title: Remove mitochondrial and unplaced reads
steps.instruction: Exclude reads mapping to mitochondrial DNA and to unplaced contigs before peak calling.

steps.title: Call peaks with MACS2
steps.instruction: Identify open chromatin regions by peak calling using MACS2 version 2.1.2.

steps.title: Merge and count peaks
steps.instruction: Perform pairwise comparisons: merge peaks from both conditions and count reads under each merged peak.

steps.title: Retain reproducible peaks
steps.instruction: Keep peaks that are present in ≥ 66 % of samples per group for downstream analysis.
